subject: Commercial onramp — Novus Health buy-plan synthesis & proposed MAP
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Kelly <sam.kelly@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial onramp — Novus Health buy-plan synthesis & proposed MAP

Sam — great chat today. Quick recap and a suggested mutual action plan so we have shared expectations for the next 60 days. Please confirm or flag edits.

Key pain & goals we captured:
- Latency spikes on peak batches (current CPU-based pipeline) — target p95 < 250ms for critical inference paths.
- Cost unpredictability as QPS scales (esp. embedding-heavy workflows) — aim to reduce per-1k-token spend by ~40% vs current infra.
- Data residency & PHI handling for triage data — requirement: VPC/private deployment option + KMS integration.
- Success metric: production pilot (5 endpoints, 1M tokens/day) within 8–10 weeks, with performance and cost report.

Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, suggested dates):
1) Technical kickoff & access (Novus dev + Redwood infra) — Owner: Vanessa (Redwood) / Sam (Novus) — target: 2028-03-28
2) PoC environment ready (private namespace, KMS, sample dataset) — Owner: Dev Patel (Redwood SE) — target: 2028-04-07
3) Baseline performance run & instrumentation (latency, cost per token) — Owner: Novus devs + Dev Patel — target: 2028-04-14
4) Tuning & batch/quantization recommendations — Owner: Dev Patel / Marissa Cole (Redwood Optimize lead) — target: 2028-04-21
5) Exec review & procurement check (pricing model + reserved capacity option) — Owner: Sam / Ben Carter (Redwood) — target: 2028-04-28
6) Decision & roll plan (canary schedule + SLA) — Owner: Sam / Vanessa — target: 2028-05-05

Stakeholders (who we should loop):
- Novus: Sam Kelly (PM), Tina Liao (Head of SRE), procurement/Legal (cc if needed)
- Redwood: Vanessa Ortiz (AE), Ben Carter (Sales), Marissa Cole (Customer Success), Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer)

Decision process & procurement notes:
- Sam indicated a two-step procurement: technical acceptance (PoC sign-off) then commercial contract (SOW + reserved capacity). Procurement window likely 2–3 weeks after PoC sign-off.

Attachments: I put a draft MAP spreadsheet (Novus-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 summary. I also linked a Drive folder for shared artifacts.

Asks / next steps:
- Please confirm the MAP dates above or suggest alternatives by EOD Wed (2028-03-24).
- Tina / Sam — can you confirm who from procurement/legal we should loop when we reach the commercial review?
- Novus: please share a representative sample (anonymized) data slice for the baseline run, or confirm Redwood may use our synthetic generator for initial tuning.

Thanks again — I'll schedule the technical kickoff for 3/28 at 10am PT unless you prefer a different slot.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0167
From: Sam Kelly <sam.kelly@novushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tina Liao <tina.liao@novushealth.com>, legal@novushealth.com
Date: 2028-03-23T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp — Novus Health buy-plan synthesis & proposed MAP

Vanessa — thanks for the clear write-up, really helpful. A few quick points and adjustments: 

1) Dates — 3/28 tech kickoff works for our core team, but Tina has a standing conflict at 10am PT. Can we move the kickoff to 11:30am PT?
2) PoC scope — we want the pilot to include two production-like endpoints (triage and discharge summarization) plus one embedding endpoint used by search. If possible, prioritize the triage endpoint for the low-latency SLA.
3) Procurement/legal — loop legal@novushealth.com early; they will want an inventory of logging/audit capabilities and a data deletion plan.
4) Data — we'll provide an anonymized sample within 48 hours. If Redwood can run initial tuning on synthetic data, that helps accelerate the baseline.

I attached the names for procurement and the SRE lead who will take the hands-on work when we kick off. I also attached a draft question list from legal in case Redwood can pre-answer.

Looking forward — please update the MAP with the time change and we'll sign off.

Sam
Product Manager, Novus Health
sam.kelly@novushealth.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Kelly <sam.kelly@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp — Novus Health buy-plan synthesis & proposed MAP

Appreciate the quick reply, Sam — 11:30am PT on 3/28 is updated and I'll send the invite.

Dev & Marissa — copying you to confirm PoC environment requirements (private namespace + KMS) and to flag the triage endpoint as the latency priority.

Ben — will start prepping a commercial outline and draft SOW so legal has something to review during the procurement window.

Sam — we'll use the synthetic generator to run initial tuning tomorrow and then swap in your anonymized sample when you upload. Expect a short SOC2/audit brief from me this afternoon to help legal.

If there are no objections, I'll push the updated MAP (v1.1) to the Drive and share the HubSpot record (HS-4831) so we all have visibility.

Thanks — see you on the call.

—
Vanessa
